# PatryCode

> Portfolio of Patryk Kubacki, a full-stack developer building web applications, websites and API integrations. Available in Polish and English.

## Website content

- [Polish overview](https://patrycode.net/index.md): developer introduction, projects and contact links.
- [English overview](https://patrycode.net/en/index.md): the same website content in English.

## Projects

- [SEPE](https://sepe.patrycode.net/prezentacja/): time tracking, leave requests and team communication.
- [Śląski Ikarus](https://rezerwacje.simkol.pl/): vintage bus ticket booking and QR validation.
